text: MSU Extension Service - Mississippi State University Skip to main content The Mississippi State University Extension Service Every day, Mississippians are developing dynamic skills through Extension’s practical, community-based education. The Mississippi State University Extension Service offers learning opportunities without boundaries. Extension education is based on community needs and what local people say they want to learn—about families, kids, agriculture, nutrition, business, gardening, community development, and more. When you support educational programs in Extension’s five major subject areas—agriculture, natural resources, 4-H youth development, family and consumer sciences, and government and community development—you are helping Extension deliver meaningful impacts where it counts most: local Mississippi communities. If you want to designate your gift to a specific Extension area or program, in a particular location, e.g., Lowndes County 4-H Shooting Sports, list that information in Comments. Thank you for supporting Extension, extending knowledge and changing lives—from our backyard to anywhere.
